scripts.build: tsc && vite build && npm run copy-files
scripts.copy-files: cp manifest.json dist/ && cp public/rules.json dist/ && cp src/ui/block-screen/index.html dist/block-screen.html && cp src/ui/block-screen/block-screen.css dist/ && cp src/ui/popup/index.html dist/popup.html && mkdir -p dist/icons && (cp public/icons/*.png dist/icons/ 2>/dev/null || true)
